metadata.title: Building & Integrating Applications of AI in Fullstack Healthcare Software
metadata.description: A practitioner's roadmap to mastering AI integration in provider-facing healthcare software — from foundational ML concepts through production-grade agentic systems, covering every AI modality relevant to clinical workflows, administrative operations, and patient engagement.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Healthcare data standards, regulatory landscape, and ML fundamentals that underpin all subsequent domains.

sections.title: Core AI Modalities
sections.description: The major AI paradigms applied to healthcare: predictive, generative, knowledge, and perception AI.

sections.title: Model Adaptation
sections.description: Fine-tuning foundation models for healthcare domains with regulatory-compliant change control.

sections.title: Production & Safety
sections.description: Decisioning systems, safety guardrails, clinical evaluation, and production observability for healthcare AI.

sections.title: Autonomous Systems
sections.description: Agentic AI systems that orchestrate multi-step clinical workflows with human oversight.
